details:
Q1. Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The issue → PR pipeline workflows (clarify / plan / implement / review_autofix)
B. The orchestrator (orchestrate / orchestrate_poll and their scripts)
C. Documentation (README.md, docs/, agents.md fragments)
D. A specific file or workflow I will name in my answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure (please link the failing run or describe the symptom) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Cut cost or runtime (tokens, API calls, runner minutes)
C. Make it more reliable or self-healing (fewer stalls or manual holds)
D. Make the docs or operator experience clearer
Q3. How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete, testable criterion I will state in my answer (for example "workflow X no longer fails with error Y") (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable target (for example "cut runtime or failure rate of X by N%")
C. No fixed criterion: plan a small, surgical improvement to the area chosen in Q1
